tickets.title: Coordinate Divorce Planning Documents
tickets.text: Coordinate the planning document flow for Nadia Pebblefizz regarding her separation from Rowan Pebblefizz. The packet must cover draft settlement terms, asset schedules, support estimates, retirement-account order questions, and current statements. This work requires written authorization before coordinating with attorney Corin Nettlewhisk and CPA Jules Thimblefern.

subTasks.title: Confirm document scope and permissions
subTasks.text: Identify which documents are needed, such as draft or final settlement terms, asset schedules, support obligations, retirement account orders, tax returns, and current statements. Confirm the client's written permission before coordinating with an attorney, CPA, or mediator.

subTasks.title: Create secure collection folder
subTasks.text: Set up a secure upload location, list missing items, and label received documents by category. Do not request or store unnecessary sensitive documents beyond the planning scope.

subTasks.title: Prepare planning summary for advisor review
subTasks.text: Summarize available assets, liabilities, income obligations, beneficiary concerns, account titling issues, and open questions for the advisor. Flag any urgent implementation constraints without providing legal conclusions.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2026-07-17 to coordinate with attorney Corin Nettlewhisk and CPA Jules Thimblefern after written authorization, with a planning packet covering draft settlement terms, asset schedules, support estimates, retirement-account order questions, and current statements.

tickets.title: Collect Client Tax Documents
tickets.text: Request and organize current tax documents for Nadia Pebblefizz's planning review. Specifically, the most recent joint return, latest property tax bill, and current Teacup Comet Bank mortgage payoff are needed by 2026-07-15. Note that current brokerage statements and pay stubs are already in the secure folder.
tickets.evidence: For the cash-flow and basis review, the most recent joint return, latest property tax bill, and current Teacup Comet Bank mortgage payoff are still needed by 2026-07-15, though current brokerage statements and pay stubs are in the secure folder.

tickets.title: Review Account Security Follow-Up Evidence
tickets.text: Review the account security follow-up for Nadia Pebblefizz regarding her failed multi-factor authentication on her replacement phone. Confirm that Elena Cloudpuddle completed identity verification and restored secure portal access on 2026-07-06, and document the client's preferred secure contact method for future updates.
tickets.evidence: Elena completed identity verification and restored secure portal access on 2026-07-06 after multi-factor authentication failed on Nadia’s replacement phone.

tickets.title: Review Concentrated Position
tickets.text: Assess Nadia Pebblefizz's employer plan position at Clockwork Clover Systems, which holds about $412,000 mostly in target-date and large-company equity funds. Evaluate position size, tax basis, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, trading restrictions, and diversification options before recommending any action, especially given the separation context.
tickets.evidence: Nadia earns a $168,000 salary plus annual bonus target at Clockwork Clover Systems; her employer plan holds about $412,000, mostly in target-date and large-company equity funds.

tickets.title: Coordinate Missing Signature Follow-Up
tickets.text: Coordinate the internal handoff to check forms against Corin Nettlewhisk's temporary restrictions for Nadia Pebblefizz. The agreed follow-up by 2026-07-24 is to verify that no beneficiary change is submitted until these restrictions are confirmed. This involves validating the missing signature requirement regarding the beneficiary record still naming Rowan Pebblefizz.

subTasks.title: Validate the missing signature requirement
subTasks.text: Review the form package and processing notes to identify the exact missing signature or authorization regarding the beneficiary record still naming Rowan Pebblefizz. Confirm whether wet signature, e-signature, or custodian-specific language is required before any change.

subTasks.title: Confirm planning or account impact
subTasks.text: Determine whether the missing signature or restriction affects account opening, transfer timing, trading authority, beneficiary changes, or other planning deadlines for Nadia Pebblefizz. Note any client-facing implications for the advisor regarding the separation.

subTasks.title: Send corrected signature request
subTasks.text: Contact Nadia Pebblefizz through the approved secure channel with clear instructions regarding the temporary restrictions imposed by attorney Corin Nettlewhisk. Avoid sending unnecessary pages containing sensitive information until restrictions are cleared.

subTasks.title: Advisor confirmation before resubmission
subTasks.text: Review the completed correction and confirm the package is ready for resubmission or escalation if Nadia Pebblefizz has questions about the request regarding the beneficiary record still naming Rowan Pebblefizz.
